title: SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of a Specify skill definition file.

name.description: Skill identifier; lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; max 64 chars; must match directory name. Avoid reserved words 'anthropic' and 'claude' (Anthropic platform policy).

description.description: One-line description including when to use the skill (max 1024 chars per Anthropic spec). Avoid XML tags.

license.description: License identifier (SPDX ID, custom name, or path to a bundled LICENSE file).

argument-hint.description: Argument pattern using bare names for required and a ? suffix for optional (e.g. "source-path output-dir kind value source-key k?"). Use literal pipes for choices (a|b|c) and ... for repeatables. No --flag prefix, no angle or square brackets.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated tool names (matches Cursor and Claude Code spec).

compatibility.description: Environment requirements such as system packages or network access (Cursor).

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value mapping for additional metadata (Cursor).

disable-model-invocation.description: When true, the skill is only included when explicitly invoked via /skill-name; the agent will not auto-trigger it (Cursor + Claude Code).

when_to_use.description: Additional trigger phrases or example requests appended to the description in the skill listing (Claude Code).

user-invocable.description: When false, hide the skill from the / menu so only the agent can invoke it (Claude Code).

paths.description: Glob patterns that limit when this skill is auto-activated; comma-separated string or YAML list (Claude Code).
